observed_fact: Tua took first-team 11-on-11 reps and started the preseason opener (~one series); Stefanski declined to name a Week 1 starter; Penix did not play.
fantasy_implication: Confirm the Week 1 starter before finalizing draft-day values for London and Pitts.

observed_fact: AJC reported the Falcons plan a complementary Bijan/Brian Robinson split with BRob handling short-yardage and goal-line work previously held by Allgeier; no fixed touch percentages set.
fantasy_implication: Bijan's rush-TD ceiling is the main risk; BRob gains standalone/handcuff goal-line value.

observed_fact: ESPN camp intel: London is the top camp performer by receptions; Dotson drew route-running praise; Branch flashed on a deep TD in 7-on-7 (non-padded).

observed_fact: The NFL suspended edge James Pearce Jr. for the first eight games; he is eligible to return Week 9.
